name: 60563 · Naperville, IL
findings: ZIP 60563 (Naperville) has 202 nonprofit organizations. 87 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60563 (Naperville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
